title: fagus japonica var. undulata
intro: Fagus japonica var. undulata, commonly known as Japanese Maple, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to Japan. The leaves of the Japanese Maple have been used in traditional medicine for their purported health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Fagus japonica var. undulata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, contributing to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation. The leaves have been used as an anti-inflammatory and anti-oxidative agent in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various conditions, including fever, cough, and digestive issues.
